item.title: Israel says Iranian leader who ordered Strait of Hormuz closure killed in targeted strike
item.summary: Israel has eliminated Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy Commander Alireza Tangsiri in a strike, Israel's Minister of Defense Israel Katz indicated.

item.title: Trump tells 'strange' Iranian negotiators to 'get serious soon' or 'it won't be pretty'
item.summary: Iranian negotiators must "get serious" about a deal to end the war, President Donald Trump warned in a Truth Social post, threatening "no turning back."

item.title: Bills star Dion Dawkins explains his 'counter' to potential NFL 18th game: 'Careers are only getting shorter'
item.summary: Buffalo Bills left tackle Dion Dawkins said an NFL 18th game may be inevitable, but warned that one extra game can change a player's entire career trajectory.

item.title: IOC announces new policy to ensure only females compete in women's competitions
item.summary: The IOC announced a new policy limiting women's Olympic competition to biological females, using SRY gene screening, effective for the LA28 Games onwards.

item.title: Cornyn counters Paxton with wave of GOP endorsements as party warns critical Texas seat at risk
item.summary: Sen. John Cornyn, R-Texas, has received a slate of 17 new endorsements from Texas Republicans in the latest development in the bitter primary runoff battle between him Ken Paxton.

item.title: Baseball Hall of Fame pitcher goes in depth how ABS system will improve offense, how arms have to adjust
item.summary: CC Sabathia praises the MLB pitch clock for bringing fans back to ballparks and says the new ABS ball-strike challenge system will help get every call right.

item.title: Paige Spiranac offers crucial golf tips for busty women
item.summary: Paige Spiranac just wants to help. The famous golf influencer posted a video trying to help big-breasted women with their swing game on Wednesday.

item.title: The clock is ticking: DHS shutdown endangers FIFA World Cup security preparations
item.summary: The DHS shutdown is threatening 2026 FIFA World Cup security, with 95% of TSA employees unpaid and callout rates growing worse at major U.S. airports.

item.title: 24 states back challenge to transgender inmate surgery ruling with nationwide stakes
item.summary: Idaho and Indiana AGs argue the Eighth Amendment doesn't require states to fund gender reassignment surgery for prison inmates in a Ninth Circuit brief.

item.title: GOP lawmaker aims radical new transparency measures ahead of 2026 election
item.summary: A new GOP bill would cut federal funding to states that refuse to disclose private election vendor contracts and foreign ties in a major transparency effort ahead of the 2026 elections.
